arg.name: mock_mode
arg.description: Run arm_controller and rfid_reader without physical hardware

arg.name: object_map_path
arg.description: Override path to object_map.yaml (defaults to installed config)

arg.name: positions_path
arg.description: Override path to arm_positions.yaml (defaults to installed config)

arg.name: arm_command_timeout
arg.description: Seconds to wait for /arm/status before treating a command as failed

arg.name: rfid_timeout
arg.description: Seconds to wait for /rfid/tag once parked at RFID_SCAN_POSITION before aborting the cycle

arg.name: move_settle_seconds
arg.description: Seconds to wait after each named-position move is acknowledged, so the servos physically arrive

arg.name: gripper_settle_seconds
arg.description: Seconds to wait after GRIPPER OPEN / GRIPPER CLOSE is acknowledged

arg.name: rfid_settle_seconds
arg.description: Extra seconds to wait after arriving at RFID_SCAN_POSITION before waiting for a tag

arg.name: joint_gap_seconds
arg.description: Seconds to wait after each joint command within a position move before sending the next joint (not after the last joint)
